content.short: AUTOfinance automates liquidity management, rebalancing LP positions across DeFi protocols.
content.description: AUTOfinance manages concentrated liquidity positions automatically, rebalancing ranges as prices move so that providers are not left with capital sitting outside the active band. Concentrated liquidity raised capital efficiency sharply but turned liquidity provision into an active job, which is the gap automated managers exist to fill.
